events.title: West End Art Club
events.description: West End Art Club starts in term 2 Can’t wait for school holiday art camp!? You can now join VA resident artist Chloë Waddell every Tuesday after school for some weekly art making. Tuesday afternoon classes will run on a 10 week term schedule with students being introduced to a variety of artmaking materials, skills & techniques across the 10 week class.Classes will be for a maximum of 8 kids to allow for plenty of one on one assistance. A large focus of West End Art Club will be encouraging participants to build their own creative identity and supporting them to realise their own creative ideas while introducing them to new materials, teaching new skills and offering new ways to look at things. Classes at the start of term will be more structured with specific goals and outcomes in mind. As the term progresses and participants build their creative confidence and develop preferences for materials and styles of making, they will have more freedom to explore their own ideas and spend more time using their medium/media of choice. The content of these classes will be flexible to allow us to meet the needs and interests of the children involved. It will include such activities as: drawing, painting, collage, printmaking, sculpture, assemblage etc. If your kids have attended one of Chloë’s workshops before, you can be assured they will be doing new things and exploring new ideas. All Chloë’s workshops are designed with the belief that art is a powerful medium through which children can explore, discover, and express their inner world in a supportive and fun environment. Overall, these workshops lay a solid foundation for your child's creative life and contribute to their holistic development. The emphasis on process and fun ensures that the joy of creation remains at the core of their artistic experiences. *SIBLING DISCOUNT - 5% DISCOUNT FOR BOOKINGS OF 2 OR MORE KIDS FROM THE SAME FAMILY **AFTER SCHOOL COLLECTION FROM WEST END STATE SCHOOL AVAILABLE If you have any questions that haven’t been answered here, please email Chloë directly at mschloewaddell@gmail.com #block-be38d6f9ccb3ebf80b74 { --stroke-style: none;--stroke-thickness: 6px; events.title: Convergent Bodies: First Leap
events.description: Image Credit: Bianca Tainsh (microscopy image with Sandra Tuszynska) Convergent Bodies is a visceral self-identification with other interspecies bodies and the emergence of a speculative posthuman future where technology is applied as ecological steward and interlocutor for entanglement with the more-than-human. In an 11-week OCCUPY residency, artist Bianca Tainsh has been visualising this concept through experimental juxtapositions of a vast exploratory archive of organic artefacts and digital documentation, and an accumulating body of aesthetic and conceptual research exploring microscopic and subterranean realms and the relational and metaphysical entanglement of all species. Unlike Haeckel's Art Forms in Nature , Tainsh's archive seeks the wild asymmetries of decay, sexual manifestation, and symbiosis.  OPENING EVENT : 5-8 pm, Friday 18th September EXHIBITION CONTINUES: 10am–3pm, Saturday 19th and Sunday 20th September 

 Also on show and for sale will be a series of reflective works, created through Tainsh's explorations of the more-than-human landscape of Lake Weyba, Kabi Kabi Country. Many of these works have not been exhibited in Queensland. Peruse a mini library of books that will open your mind to the alternative and inspiring views that art, radical research, and Indigenous cosmology offer in the face of our polycrisis and detachment from the more-than-human world to which we belong. Bianca will be on site if you'd like to explore the concepts that are interlaced through her works.
